opacity: .85; }\n# Copy to .env (which is gitignored) and change the values. On a fresh clone\n# with no .env, the app and the seed read this file instead.\nCMS_SECRET_KEY=change-me-to-a-long-random-string\nCMS_SITE_TITLE=Club de Aficionados Albiazul\nCMS_DATABASE=cms.db\n# Demo accounts created by scripts/seed_demo.py (both members share the editor password)\nCMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=change-me-admin\nCMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD=change-me-editor\n# Set after you deploy, e.g. https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nCMS_BASE_PATH=\n# Your name for the transcript hook, lowercase, e.g. ana-garcia\nCMS_STUDENT=first-last\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Rebuild the demo database from scratch, with fictional data only.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nWipes the database at CMS_DATABASE and creates the leader, two members, a\nmember's draft post, a member's post submitted for review, one published post\nin each topic, a member's pending edit to one of them, and the fan club's four\npages, published, in menu order.\nPasswords come from CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD (read from .env,\nor from .env.example on a fresh clone); they are never printed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom dataclasses import replace\n\nfrom app import accounts, content, db, settings\nfrom app.content import PageFields, PostFields\n\n# (email, nickname, role, environment variable holding the password).\n# tests/conftest.py uses the same emails and nicknames.\nDEMO_USERS = [\n    (\"lider@albiazul.example\", \"El Capi\", \"admin\", \"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"),\n    (\"ana@albiazul.example\", \"Rayada de Corazón\", \"editor\", \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"),\n    (\"beto@albiazul.example\", \"Furia del Cerro\", \"editor\", \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"),\n]\n\n# A post its member is still writing (written by ana@).\nDRAFT = PostFields(\n    title=\"Lo que se vio desde la cabecera norte\",\n    topic=\"match\",\n    body=(\n        \"Todavía lo estoy escribiendo, pero va la idea:\\n\\n\"\n        \"- El primer tiempo fue **puro Rayados**.\\n\"\n        \"- En el segundo nos faltó *cerrar el partido*.\\n\\n\"\n        \"> Aquí se viene a alentar, no a sufrir. (Mi tío, cada sábado.)\\n\\n\"\n        \"Mañana le agrego lo del gol del triunfo.\\n\"\n    ),\n)\n\n# A post its member has submitted, waiting for the leader (written by beto@).\nSUBMITTED = PostFields(\n    title=\"Tres cambios que yo haría al medio tiempo\",\n    topic=\"coach\",\n    body=(\n        \"Cuando el partido se traba, el técnico tiene que mover algo antes del 60.\\n\\n\"\n        \"1. Meter velocidad por la banda izquierda.\\n\"\n        \"2. Adelantar la presión diez metros.\\n\"\n        \"3. Un medio que pise el área, no solo que dé pases de lado.\\n\\n\"\n        \"Ojo: **no estoy pidiendo que lo corran**, nomás que se arriesgue un poquito más.\\n\"\n    ),\n)\n\n# A published post (written by ana@) that she then changes: her change waits for\n# the leader as a pending edit while this version stays public.\nLINEUP = PostFields(\n    title=\"El once que yo pondría el sábado\",\n    topic=\"lineup\",\n    body=(\n        \"Sin nombres, que luego se enojan en el grupo. Lo que pido es **orden atrás**\"\n        \" y velocidad por las bandas:\\n\\n\"\n        \"1. El portero de siempre, que anda en racha.\\n\"\n        \"2. Línea de cuatro, con el lateral izquierdo bien ofensivo.\\n\"\n        \"3. Dos de contención, para que no nos agarren al contragolpe.\\n\"\n        \"4. Arriba, el nueve fijo y alguien que llegue desde atrás.\\n\\n\"\n        \"¿Ustedes cómo lo armarían?\\n\"\n    ),\n)\nPENDING_EDIT = replace(\n    LINEUP,\n    title=\"El once que yo pondría el sábado (con tres centrales)\",\n    body=LINEUP.body + (\n        \"\\n**Actualización:** viendo el entrenamiento del jueves, cambio una cosa: tres\"\n        \" centrales y los laterales bien abiertos, de carrileros.\\n\"\n    ),\n)\n\n# One published post per topic, as (author's email, post). The Partido one is a\n# tiradera aimed at Tigres: allowed by the house rules, which forbid only\n# personal attacks. No real person is named.\nPUBLISHED = [\n    (\"beto@albiazul.example\", PostFields(\n        title=\"Tigres, traigan pañuelos al Clásico Regio\",\n        topic=\"match\",\n        body=(\n            \"Se viene otro Clásico Regio y en la cabecera ya estamos listos.\\n\\n\"\n            \"A los de **Tigres**, con cariño: vayan comprando pañuelos, porque el sábado\"\n            \" el Cerro de la Silla se pinta de azul y blanco. Mucho rugido entre semana\"\n            \" y puro maullido en la cancha.\\n\\n\"\n            \"- Llegar temprano.\\n\"\n            \"- Cantar los noventa minutos.\\n\"\n            \"- Volver a casa con los tres puntos.\\n\"\n        ),\n    )),\n    (\"ana@albiazul.example\", LINEUP),\n    (\"ana@albiazul.example\", PostFields(\n        title=\"Al técnico hay que darle tiempo\",\n        topic=\"coach\",\n        body=(\n            \"Llevamos pocas jornadas con el cuerpo técnico nuevo y ya hay quien pide\"\n            \" cambios. Yo digo que no.\\n\\n\"\n            \"> Los procesos se juzgan al final del torneo, no después de un empate.\\n\\n\"\n            \"Ya se nota la idea: presión alta y salir jugando desde atrás. Falta afinar,\"\n            \" pero vamos bien.\\n\"\n        ),\n    )),\n    (\"beto@albiazul.example\", PostFields(\n        title=\"Lo que nos falta en el mercado de invierno\",\n        topic=\"signings\",\n        body=(\n            \"Con un **lateral izquierdo** y un central rápido nos alcanza para pelear\"\n            \" arriba. No hace falta tirar la casa por la ventana: hace falta acertar.\\n\\n\"\n            \"Y que esta vez lleguen *antes* de la pretemporada.\\n\"\n        ),\n    )),\n    (\"lider@albiazul.example\", PostFields(\n        title=\"Watch party del Clásico Regio\",\n        topic=\"fan-club-news\",\n        body=(\n            \"Este sábado vemos el Clásico juntos. Traigan su jersey, su bandera y su\"\n            \" mejor garganta.\\n\\n\"\n            \"- **Hora:** una hora antes del partido.\\n\"\n            \"- **Lugar:** se lo mandamos por mensaje a cada miembro.\\n\"\n            \"- **Regla de oro:** la tiradera a Tigres se vale; las faltas de respeto, no.\\n\"\n        ),\n    )),\n]\n\n\n# The fan club's own pages, written by the leader and published, in menu order.\nPAGES = [\n    PageFields(\n        title=\"Quiénes somos\",\n        menu_order=\"1\",\n        body=(\n            \"Somos el **Club de Aficionados Albiazul**: aficionados de Rayados que nos\"\n            \" juntamos a ver los partidos, a cantar y a opinar. No somos Rayados ni\"\n            \" hablamos por el equipo: somos fans, nada más y nada menos.\\n\\n\"\n            \"Aquí los miembros escriben lo que piensan del equipo (el partido, la\"\n            \" alineación, el técnico, los fichajes) y el líder del club de aficionados\"\n            \" revisa cada publicación antes de que salga al sitio.\\n\"\n        ),\n    ),\n    PageFields(\n        title=\"Próximos partidos\",\n        menu_order=\"2\",\n        body=(\n            \"Así nos organizamos para los próximos partidos. El líder actualiza esta\"\n            \" página cada semana.\\n\\n\"\n            \"- **Clásico Regio:** watch party del club de aficionados. El lugar se avisa\"\n            \" por mensaje a cada miembro.\\n\"\n            \"- **Partidos en casa:** nos vemos en la cabecera norte, con jersey y bandera.\\n\"\n            \"- **Partidos de visita:** los vemos juntos donde siempre; llega una hora antes.\\n\\n\"\n            \"Los horarios oficiales los publica Rayados; aquí solo te decimos dónde nos\"\n            \" juntamos.\\n\"\n        ),\n    ),\n    PageFields(\n        title=\"Reglas de la casa\",\n        menu_order=\"3\",\n        body=(\n            \"El líder revisa cada publicación antes de que salga al sitio, y la revisa con\"\n            \" estas reglas.\\n\\n\"\n            \"## Se vale: la tiradera\\n\\n\"\n            \"La tiradera a un club rival o a su afición (a Tigres, sobre todo) es parte de\"\n            \" ser aficionado. Búrlate del rival, de su racha o de su estadio todo lo que\"\n            \" quieras.\\n\\n\"\n            \"## Nunca: el ataque personal\\n\\n\"\n            \"Un ataque personal es una agresión contra una persona real (un jugador, un\"\n            \" árbitro, un aficionado, un periodista) o una amenaza contra una persona o un\"\n            \" lugar. No se publica nunca, se diga como se diga, ni aunque sea «de broma».\\n\\n\"\n            \"## Cómo se aplican\\n\\n\"\n            \"- Si una publicación cruza la línea, el líder la devuelve a quien la escribió\"\n            \" para que la corrija.\\n\"\n            \"- Quien insista en los ataques personales pierde su cuenta.\\n\"\n        ),\n    ),\n    PageFields(\n        title=\"Cómo unirse\",\n        menu_order=\"4\",\n        body=(\n            \"Para escribir en el sitio necesitas una cuenta, y las cuentas las crea el líder\"\n            \" del club de aficionados.\\n\\n\"\n            \"1. Escribe a [unete@albiazul.example](mailto:unete@albiazul.example) con tu\"\n            \" nombre y desde cuándo le vas a Rayados.\\n\"\n            \"2. El líder te responde con tu correo de acceso y una contraseña temporal.\\n\"\n            \"3. La primera vez que entres eliges tu apodo: es el nombre que verán los\"\n            \" lectores en tus publicaciones.\\n\\n\"\n            \"Antes de escribir, lee las reglas de la casa.\\n\"\n        ),\n    ),\n]\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    missing = sorted({var for *_, var in DEMO_USERS if not os.environ.get(var)})\n    if missing:\n        print(f\"Set {', '.join(missing)} in .env (copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    path = settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    path.unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    db.init(path)\n    with closing(db.connect(path)) as conn:\n        users = {email: accounts.create_user(conn, email=email, password=os.environ[var],\n                                             role=role, nickname=nickname)\n                 for email, nickname, role, var in DEMO_USERS}\n        content.create_post(conn, users[\"ana@albiazul.example\"], DRAFT)\n        submitted = content.create_post(conn, users[\"beto@albiazul.example\"], SUBMITTED)\n        content.move(conn, submitted, content.SUBMIT)\n        for email, fields in PUBLISHED:\n            # The seed acts as the leader; in the console a member's post is\n            # submitted before the leader can publish it.\n            post = content.move(conn, content.create_post(conn, users[email], fields),\n                                content.PUBLISH)\n            if fields is LINEUP:\n                content.propose_edit(conn, post, PENDING_EDIT)\n        for page_fields in PAGES:\n            page = content.create_page(conn, users[\"lider@albiazul.example\"], page_fields)\n            content.move_page(conn, page, content.PUBLISH_PAGE)\n\n    print(f\"Rebuilt {path} with these demo accounts:\")\n    for email, nickname, role, var in DEMO_USERS:\n        print(f\"  {email:<26} {role:<7} {nickname}  (password: ${var})\")\n    print(f\"one draft post ({DRAFT.title}), one post waiting for review ({SUBMITTED.title}),\"\n          f\" {len(PUBLISHED)} published posts, one per topic, a pending edit to\"\n          f\" {LINEUP.title}, and {len(PAGES)} published pages for the menu.\"\n          \" Run `uv run cms publish` to export them to site/.\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"fc8cc488-406d-40d5-a453-579a328c558b","timestamp":"2026-10-11T17:41:03.885Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"<!doctype On a fresh clone\n# with no .env, the app and the seed read this file instead.\nCMS_SECRET_KEY=change-me-to-a-long-random-string\nCMS_SITE_TITLE=Club de Aficionados Albiazul\nCMS_DATABASE=cms.db\n# Demo accounts created by scripts/seed_demo.py (both members share the editor password)\nCMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=change-me-admin\nCMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD=change-me-editor\n# Set after you deploy, e.g. https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nCMS_BASE_PATH=\n# Your name for the transcript hook, lowercase, e.g. ana-garcia\nCMS_STUDENT=first-last\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Rebuild the demo database from scratch, with fictional data only.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nWipes the database at CMS_DATABASE and creates the leader, two members, a\nmember's draft post, a member's post submitted for review, one published post\nin each topic, a member's pending edit to one of them, and the fan club's four\npages, published, in menu order.\nPasswords come from CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD (read from .env,\nor from .env.example on a fresh clone); they are never printed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom dataclasses import replace\n\nfrom app import accounts, content, db, settings\nfrom app.content import PageFields, PostFields\n\n# (email, nickname, role, environment variable holding the password).\n# tests/conftest.py uses the same emails and nicknames.\nDEMO_USERS = [\n    (\"lider@albiazul.example\", \"El Capi\", \"admin\", \"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"),\n    (\"ana@albiazul.example\", \"Rayada de Corazón\", \"editor\", \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"),\n    (\"beto@albiazul.example\", \"Furia del Cerro\", \"editor\", \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"),\n]\n\n# A post its member is still writing (written by ana@).\nDRAFT = PostFields(\n    title=\"Lo que se vio desde la cabecera norte\",\n    topic=\"match\",\n    body=(\n        \"Todavía lo estoy escribiendo, pero va la idea:\\n\\n\"\n        \"- El primer tiempo fue **puro Rayados**.\\n\"\n        \"- En el segundo nos faltó *cerrar el partido*.\\n\\n\"\n        \"> Aquí se viene a alentar, no a sufrir. (Mi tío, cada sábado.)\\n\\n\"\n        \"Mañana le agrego lo del gol del triunfo.\\n\"\n    ),\n)\n\n# A post its member has submitted, waiting for the leader (written by beto@).\nSUBMITTED = PostFields(\n    title=\"Tres cambios que yo haría al medio tiempo\",\n    topic=\"coach\",\n    body=(\n        \"Cuando el partido se traba, el técnico tiene que mover algo antes del 60.\\n\\n\"\n        \"1. Meter velocidad por la banda izquierda.\\n\"\n        \"2. Adelantar la presión diez metros.\\n\"\n        \"3. Un medio que pise el área, no solo que dé pases de lado.\\n\\n\"\n        \"Ojo: **no estoy pidiendo que lo corran**, nomás que se arriesgue un poquito más.\\n\"\n    ),\n)\n\n# A published post (written by ana@) that she then changes: her change waits for\n# the leader as a pending edit while this version stays public.\nLINEUP = PostFields(\n    title=\"El once que yo pondría el sábado\",\n    topic=\"lineup\",\n    body=(\n        \"Sin nombres, que luego se enojan en el grupo. Lo que pido es **orden atrás**\"\n        \" y velocidad por las bandas:\\n\\n\"\n        \"1. El portero de siempre, que anda en racha.\\n\"\n        \"2. Línea de cuatro, con el lateral izquierdo bien ofensivo.\\n\"\n        \"3. Dos de contención, para que no nos agarren al contragolpe.\\n\"\n        \"4. Arriba, el nueve fijo y alguien que llegue desde atrás.\\n\\n\"\n        \"¿Ustedes cómo lo armarían?\\n\"\n    ),\n)\nPENDING_EDIT = replace(\n    LINEUP,\n    title=\"El once que yo pondría el sábado (con tres centrales)\",\n    body=LINEUP.body + (\n        \"\\n**Actualización:** viendo el entrenamiento del jueves, cambio una cosa: tres\"\n        \" centrales y los laterales bien abiertos, de carrileros.\\n\"\n    ),\n)\n\n# One published post per topic, as (author's email, post). The Partido one is a\n# tiradera aimed at Tigres: allowed by the house rules, which forbid only\n# personal attacks. No real person is named.\nPUBLISHED = [\n    (\"beto@albiazul.example\", PostFields(\n        title=\"Tigres, traigan pañuelos al Clásico Regio\",\n        topic=\"match\",\n        body=(\n            \"Se viene otro Clásico Regio y en la cabecera ya estamos listos.\\n\\n\"\n            \"A los de **Tigres**, con cariño: vayan comprando pañuelos, porque el sábado\"\n            \" el Cerro de la Silla se pinta de azul y blanco. Mucho rugido entre semana\"\n            \" y puro maullido en la cancha.\\n\\n\"\n            \"- Llegar temprano.\\n\"\n            \"- Cantar los noventa minutos.\\n\"\n            \"- Volver a casa con los tres puntos.\\n\"\n        ),\n    )),\n    (\"ana@albiazul.example\", LINEUP),\n    (\"ana@albiazul.example\", PostFields(\n        title=\"Al técnico hay que darle tiempo\",\n        topic=\"coach\",\n        body=(\n            \"Llevamos pocas jornadas con el cuerpo técnico nuevo y ya hay quien pide\"\n            \" cambios. Yo digo que no.\\n\\n\"\n            \"> Los procesos se juzgan al final del torneo, no después de un empate.\\n\\n\"\n            \"Ya se nota la idea: presión alta y salir jugando desde atrás. Falta afinar,\"\n            \" pero vamos bien.\\n\"\n        ),\n    )),\n    (\"beto@albiazul.example\", PostFields(\n        title=\"Lo que nos falta en el mercado de invierno\",\n        topic=\"signings\",\n        body=(\n            \"Con un **lateral izquierdo** y un central rápido nos alcanza para pelear\"\n            \" arriba. No hace falta tirar la casa por la ventana: hace falta acertar.\\n\\n\"\n            \"Y que esta vez lleguen *antes* de la pretemporada.\\n\"\n        ),\n    )),\n    (\"lider@albiazul.example\", PostFields(\n        title=\"Watch party del Clásico Regio\",\n        topic=\"fan-club-news\",\n        body=(\n            \"Este sábado vemos el Clásico juntos. Traigan su jersey, su bandera y su\"\n            \" mejor garganta.\\n\\n\"\n            \"- **Hora:** una hora antes del partido.\\n\"\n            \"- **Lugar:** se lo mandamos por mensaje a cada miembro.\\n\"\n            \"- **Regla de oro:** la tiradera a Tigres se vale; las faltas de respeto, no.\\n\"\n        ),\n    )),\n]\n\n\n# The fan club's own pages, written by the leader and published, in menu order.\nPAGES = [\n    PageFields(\n        title=\"Quiénes somos\",\n        menu_order=\"1\",\n        body=(\n            \"Somos el **Club de Aficionados Albiazul**: aficionados de Rayados que nos\"\n            \" juntamos a ver los partidos, a cantar y a opinar. No somos Rayados ni\"\n            \" hablamos por el equipo: somos fans, nada más y nada menos.\\n\\n\"\n            \"Aquí los miembros escriben lo que piensan del equipo (el partido, la\"\n            \" alineación, el técnico, los fichajes) y el líder del club de aficionados\"\n            \" revisa cada publicación antes de que salga al sitio.\\n\"\n        ),\n    ),\n    PageFields(\n        title=\"Próximos partidos\",\n        menu_order=\"2\",\n        body=(\n            \"Así nos organizamos para los próximos partidos. El líder actualiza esta\"\n            \" página cada semana.\\n\\n\"\n            \"- **Clásico Regio:** watch party del club de aficionados. El lugar se avisa\"\n            \" por mensaje a cada miembro.\\n\"\n            \"- **Partidos en casa:** nos vemos en la cabecera norte, con jersey y bandera.\\n\"\n            \"- **Partidos de visita:** los vemos juntos donde siempre; llega una hora antes.\\n\\n\"\n            \"Los horarios oficiales los publica Rayados; aquí solo te decimos dónde nos\"\n            \" juntamos.\\n\"\n        ),\n    ),\n    PageFields(\n        title=\"Reglas de la casa\",\n        menu_order=\"3\",\n        body=(\n            \"El líder revisa cada publicación antes de que salga al sitio, y la revisa con\"\n            \" estas reglas.\\n\\n\"\n            \"## Se vale: la tiradera\\n\\n\"\n            \"La tiradera a un club rival o a su afición (a Tigres, sobre todo) es parte de\"\n            \" ser aficionado. Búrlate del rival, de su racha o de su estadio todo lo que\"\n            \" quieras.\\n\\n\"\n            \"## Nunca: el ataque personal\\n\\n\"\n            \"Un ataque personal es una agresión contra una persona real (un jugador, un\"\n            \" árbitro, un aficionado, un periodista) o una amenaza contra una persona o un\"\n            \" lugar. No se publica nunca, se diga como se diga, ni aunque sea «de broma».\\n\\n\"\n            \"## Cómo se aplican\\n\\n\"\n            \"- Si una publicación cruza la línea, el líder la devuelve a quien la escribió\"\n            \" para que la corrija.\\n\"\n            \"- Quien insista en los ataques personales pierde su cuenta.\\n\"\n        ),\n    ),\n    PageFields(\n        title=\"Cómo unirse\",\n        menu_order=\"4\",\n        body=(\n            \"Para escribir en el sitio necesitas una cuenta, y las cuentas las crea el líder\"\n            \" del club de aficionados.\\n\\n\"\n            \"1. Escribe a [unete@albiazul.example](mailto:unete@albiazul.example) con tu\"\n            \" nombre y desde cuándo le vas a Rayados.\\n\"\n            \"2. El líder te responde con tu correo de acceso y una contraseña temporal.\\n\"\n            \"3. La primera vez que entres eliges tu apodo: es el nombre que verán los\"\n            \" lectores en tus publicaciones.\\n\\n\"\n            \"Antes de escribir, lee las reglas de la casa.\\n\"\n        ),\n    ),\n]\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    missing = sorted({var for *_, var in DEMO_USERS if not os.environ.get(var)})\n    if missing:\n        print(f\"Set {', '.join(missing)} in .env (copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    path = settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    path.unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    db.init(path)\n    with closing(db.connect(path)) as conn:\n        users = {email: accounts.create_user(conn, email=email, password=os.environ[var],\n                                             role=role, nickname=nickname)\n                 for email, nickname, role, var in DEMO_USERS}\n        content.create_post(conn, users[\"ana@albiazul.example\"], DRAFT)\n        submitted = content.create_post(conn, users[\"beto@albiazul.example\"], SUBMITTED)\n        content.move(conn, submitted, content.SUBMIT)\n        for email, fields in PUBLISHED:\n            # The seed acts as the leader; in the console a member's post is\n            # submitted before the leader can publish it.\n            post = content.move(conn, content.create_post(conn, users[email], fields),\n                                content.PUBLISH)\n            if fields is LINEUP:\n                content.propose_edit(conn, post, PENDING_EDIT)\n        for page_fields in PAGES:\n            page = content.create_page(conn, users[\"lider@albiazul.example\"], page_fields)\n            content.move_page(conn, page, content.PUBLISH_PAGE)\n\n    print(f\"Rebuilt {path} with these demo accounts:\")\n    for email, nickname, role, var in DEMO_USERS:\n        print(f\"  {email:<26} {role:<7} {nickname}  (password: ${var})\")\n    print(f\"one draft post ({DRAFT.title}), one post waiting for review ({SUBMITTED.title}),\"\n          f\" {len(PUBLISHED)} published posts, one per topic, a pending edit to\"\n          f\" {LINEUP.title}, and {len(PAGES)} published pages for the menu.\"\n          \" Run `uv run cms publish` to export them to site/.\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3979134c-5a53-44ee-a378-a31f34915da8","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"866aa3a5-de9e-4871-af02-52cb338083b0","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

env_example[\"CMS_STUDENT\"] == \"first-last\"\n\n\ndef test_seed_runs_clean_from_env_example_and_its_users_log_in_by_nickname(\n        tmp_path, login, demo_users, env_example, run_seed):\n    database = tmp_path / \"seeded.db\"\n    passwords = {\"admin\": env_example[\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"],\n                 \"editor\": env_example[\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"],\n                 \"editor2\": env_example[\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"]}\n\n    for _ in range(2):  # the seed wipes and rebuilds, so a second run is clean too\n        result = run_seed(database)\n        assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr\n    assert not any(p in result.stdout + result.stderr for p in passwords.values())\n\n    for role, user in demo_users.items():\n        c = TestClient(create_app(database))\n        assert login(c, user[\"email\"], passwords[role]).status_code == 303, role\n        assert user[\"nickname\"] in c.get(\"/admin\").text\n\n\ndef test_seed_creates_the_leader_and_two_members_matching_the_test_helper(\n        tmp_path, login, demo_users, env_example, run_seed, cells):\n    database = tmp_path / \"seeded.db\"\n    assert run_seed(database).returncode == 0\n    leader = TestClient(create_app(database))\n    login(leader, \"lider@albiazul.example\", env_example[\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"])\n\n    page = leader.get(\"/admin/users\").text\n\n    assert page.count(\"@albiazul.example\") == 3\n    assert page.count(\"<td>Líder</td>\") == 1 and page.count(\"<td>Miembro</td>\") == 2\n    listed = [row[:2] for row in cells(page) if row]\n    for user in demo_users.values():\n        assert [user[\"email\"], user[\"nickname\"]] in listed\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"run\", [\"first\", \"second\"])\ndef test_each_test_runs_against_its_own_fresh_temporary_database(\n        client_as, database_path, tmp_path, demo_users, run):\n    assert database_path.parent == tmp_path\n    assert database_path != settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    leader = client_as(\"admin\")\n\n    # Both runs add the same account; a shared database would make the second\n    # run see it (and refuse the duplicate email).\n    assert leader.get(\"/admin/users\").text.count(\"@albiazul.example\") == len(demo_users)\n    conn = db.connect(database_path)\n    accounts.create_user(conn, email=\"extra@albiazul.example\", password=\"extra-pw\",\n                         role=\"editor\", nickname=f\"Extra {run}\")\n    conn.close()\n\"\"\"T03 (#4): the site export writes the public site import cli, settings\n\n\ndef inside(html: str, tag: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The HTML inside the page's first <tag>, e.g. \"article\" for the post itself\n    or \"main\" for what the page says url, \"publish\")\n\n    post = inside((export() / \"posts\" / \"crónica-del-clásico-regio.html\").read_text(), \"article\")\n\n    assert \"<h1>Crónica del Clásico Regio</h1>\" in post\n    assert post\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_regenerates_site_from_scratch_from_the_database(\n        published_post, database_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):\n    published_post(title=\"Crónica del Clásico monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"DATABASE_PATH\", database_path)\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", site)\n\n    assert cli.main([\"publish\"]) == 0\n\n    assert not (site / \"posts\" / \"1 published post\" in capsys.readouterr().out\n\n\ndocs/handoff:\n\ndocs/process:\n# ADR-001: The admin console runs locally; the public site is a static export\n\n**Status:** accepted (set by the {"parentUuid":"54cfef9d-10c4-4759-87d3-5688f591c3ab","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"fd0d2e60-edf5-48a7-925a-3055a462eab6","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/maximo/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\"\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"0123c0a6-416b-4603-b4f1-85845912eb14","timestamp":"2026-10-11T17:41:08.855Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_01HvvBkWErgYnrdF8NeJiDCA","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"866aa3a5-de9e-4871-af02-52cb338083b0","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"1656786c-92ac-4f05-9b94-e4ec026036dc","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"fd0d2e60-edf5-48a7-925a-3055a462eab6","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01RyLjPQeGFzqYkEbNnnba4V","type":"tool_result","content":"# When to Mock\n\nMock at **system boundaries** only:\n\n- External APIs (payment, email, etc.)\n- Databases (sometimes - prefer test DB)\n- Time/randomness\n- File system (sometimes)\n\nDon't mock:\n\n- Your own classes/modules\n- Internal collaborators\n- Anything you control\n\n## Designing for Mockability\n\nAt system boundaries, design interfaces that are easy to mock:\n\n**1. Use dependency injection**\n\nPass external dependencies in rather than creating them internally:\n\n```typescript\n// Easy to mock\nfunction processPayment(order, paymentClient) {\n  return paymentClient.charge(order.total);\n}\n\n// Hard to mock\nfunction processPayment(order) {\n  const client = new StripeClient(process.env.STRIPE_KEY);\n  return client.charge(order.total);\n}\n```\n\n**2. Prefer SDK-style interfaces over generic fetchers**\n\nCreate specific functions for each external operation instead of one generic function with conditional logic:\n\n```typescript\n// GOOD: Each function is independently mockable\nconst api = {\n  getUser: (id) => fetch(`/users/${id}`),\n  getOrders: (userId) => fetch(`/users/${userId}/orders`),\n  createOrder: (data) => fetch('/orders', { method: 'POST', body: data }),\n};\n\n// BAD: Mocking requires conditional logic inside the mock\nconst api = {\n  fetch: (endpoint, options) => fetch(endpoint, options),\n};\n```\n\nThe SDK approach means:\n- Each mock returns one specific shape\n- No conditional logic in test setup\n- Easier to see which endpoints a test exercises\n- Type safety per endpoint\n# Issue tracker: GitHub\n\nIssues and specs for this repo live as GitHub issues. Use the `gh` CLI for all operations.\n\n## Conventions\n\n- **Create an issue**: `gh issue create --title \"...\" --body \"...\"`. Use a heredoc for multi-line bodies.\n- **Read an issue**: `gh issue view <number> --comments`, filtering comments by `jq` and also fetching labels.\n- **List issues**: `gh issue list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,comments --jq '[.[] | {number, title, body, labels: [.labels[].name], comments: [.comments[].body]}]'` with appropriate `--label` and `--state` filters.\n- **Comment on an issue**: `gh issue comment <number> --body \"...\"`\n- **Apply / remove labels**: `gh issue edit <number> --add-label \"...\"` / `--remove-label \"...\"`\n- **Close**: `gh issue close <number> --comment \"...\"`\n\nInfer the repo from `git remote -v`; `gh` does this automatically when run inside a clone.\n\n## Pull requests as a triage surface\n\n**PRs as a request surface: no.** _(Set to `yes` if this repo treats external PRs as feature requests; `/triage` reads this flag.)_\n\nWhen set to `yes`, PRs run through the same labels and states as issues, using the `gh pr` equivalents:\n\n- **Read a PR**: `gh pr view <number> --comments` and `gh pr diff <number>` for the diff.\n- **List external PRs for triage**: `gh pr list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,author,authorAssociation,comments` then keep only `authorAssociation` of `CONTRIBUTOR`, `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR`, or `NONE` (drop `OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`).\n- **Comment / label / close**: `gh pr comment`, `gh pr edit --add-label`/`--remove-label`, `gh pr close`.\n\nGitHub shares one number space across issues and PRs, so a bare `#42` may be either: resolve with `gh pr view 42` and fall back to `gh issue view 42`.\n\n## When a skill says \"publish to the issue tracker\"\n\nCreate a GitHub issue.\n\n## When a skill says \"fetch the relevant ticket\"\n\nRun `gh issue view <number> --comments`.\n\n## Wayfinding operations\n\nUsed by `/wayfinder`. The **map** is a single issue with **child** issues as tickets.\n\n- **Map**: a single issue labelled `wayfinder:map`, holding the Notes / Decisions-so-far / Fog body. `gh issue create --label wayfinder:map`.\n- **Child ticket**: an issue linked to the map as a GitHub sub-issue (`gh api` on the sub-issues endpoint). Where sub-issues aren't enabled, add the child to a task list in the map body and put `Part of #<map>` at the top of the child body. Labels: `wayfinder:<type>` (`research`/`prototype`/`grilling`/`task`). Once claimed, the ticket is assigned to the driving dev.\n- **Blocking**: GitHub's **native issue dependencies**, the canonical, UI-visible representation. Add an edge with `gh api --method POST repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<child>/dependencies/blocked_by -F issue_id=<blocker-db-id>`, where `<blocker-db-id>` is the blocker's numeric **database id** (`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n> --jq .id`, _not_ the `#number` or `node_id`). GitHub reports `issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by` (open blockers only, the live gate). Where dependencies aren't available, fall back to a `Blocked by: #<n>, #<n>` line at the top of the child body. A ticket is unblocked when every blocker is closed.\n- **Frontier query**: list the map's open children (`gh issue list --state open`, scoped to the map's sub-issues / task list), drop any with an open blocker (`issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by > 0`, or an open issue in the `Blocked by` line) or an assignee; first in map order wins.\n- **Claim**: `gh issue edit <n> --add-assignee @me`, the session's first write.\n- **Resolve**: `gh issue comment <n> --body \"<answer>\"`, then `gh issue close <n>`, then append a context pointer (gist + link) to the map's Decisions-so-far.\n\n## Course conventions (IPHS 400 MP2 rubric)\n\nThese labels are graded and sit alongside the triage labels above.\n\n- **Spec**: exactly one issue labelled `spec` (plus `ready-for-agent`). It must be created before any ticket.\n- **Tickets**: core tickets are labelled `ticket`, extra-credit tickets `stretch` (plus `ready-for-agent`). Every ticket body has an **Acceptance criteria** section and a literal `Blocked by: #N, #M` line (or `Blocked by: none`), even when native GitHub dependencies are also set.\n- **Closing a ticket**: post the `/code-review` findings and how each was resolved as a comment on the issue *before* closing it; the closing commit message starts `T0N:` and ends `Closes #N`.\n# IPHS 400 — Mini-Project #2 starter (Web CMS)\n\nClick **Use this template** → name your repo **`iphs400-mp2-cms`** → make it **Public**.\nDo not fork: a fork arrives without an Issues tab, and your tickets live in Issues.\n\n## Start here\n\n1. `docs/manual_iphs400_mp2-web-cms_20260922.md` — the manual. Read Part 0 and Part 1 first.\n2. `docs/mp2-grading-rubric_20260922.md` — how you are graded. Read it **before** you build.\n3. `docs/mp2-setup_context-threshold-hook_20260922.md` — Exercise A, in Part 4 of the manual.\n\n## Run it\n\n```bash\nuv sync\ncp .env.example .env                  # optional: without it, .env.example is used\nuv run python scripts/seed_demo.py    # wipes and rebuilds cms.db with demo accounts\nuv run cms serve                      # then open http://localhost:8000/admin\nuv run cms publish                    # export the public site to site/ from published posts and pages\npython3 -m http.server -d site 8001   # preview it at http://localhost:8001\nuv run cms deploy                     # put site/ online (the gh-pages branch)\n```\n\nDemo accounts (all fictional; passwords are the values in `.env`):\n\n| Email | Role | Nickname | Password |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `lider@albiazul.example` | leader (admin) | El Capi | `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` |\n| `ana@albiazul.example` | member (editor) | Rayada de Corazón | `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD` |\n| `beto@albiazul.example` | member (editor) | Furia del Cerro | `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD` |\n\nThe seed also adds one draft post written by Rayada de Corazón (open *Publicaciones*), one\npost by Furia del Cerro waiting for the leader's review (the *Esperando revisión* count on the\nleader's *Panel*), and one published post in each of the five topics, so the exported site has\nsomething in every section. Rayada de Corazón has also proposed changes to her published lineup\npost: the *Cambios propuestos* count on the *Panel* opens it, and the leader compares the two\nversions side by side before approving or sending them back. Last, the seed publishes the fan\nclub's four pages, which the public menu lists in this order: *Quiénes somos*, *Próximos\npartidos*, *Reglas de la casa* and *Cómo unirse*. The leader manages them under *Páginas*;\nmembers never see them in the admin console.\n\n## What is here\n\n```text\n.claude/hooks/     the context meter and usage ledger (Exercise A lives in ctx_guard.py)\nscripts/           usage_report.py (Exercise B lives in spend()), check_submission.py, seed_demo.py\ntests/             the exercise tests, plus helpers such as client_as(\"editor\")\napp/, templates/   the T00 skeleton — every CMS feature is yours to build\ndocs/adr/          two example decision records\n```\n\nTwo functions are deliberately unfinished and their tests fail until you write them:\n`decide()` in `.claude/hooks/ctx_guard.py` and `spend()` in `scripts/usage_report.py`.\nBoth are graded. Use `/tdd`, as the manual says.\n\n## Deadlines\n\nStage 1 (`mp2-mvp` tag): Tue Sep 29, 2:40 pm Eastern (soft target).\nStage 2 (`mp2-final` tag): Tue Oct 6, 2:40 pm Eastern, grace until Wed Oct 7, 2:40 pm.\n\nRun `uv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 2` before you submit.\n\n## Generative AI Use Statement\n\n*(Required. The upload is the\nfake from conftest.py, so no test pushes to GitHub.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\n\ndef text(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"What a reader sees of this HTML: tags dropped, spaces collapsed.\"\"\"\n    return re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \" \", re.sub(r\"<[^>]+>\", \" \", html)).strip()\n\n\ndef update_site(c, button_action, csrf_token):\n    \"\"\"Press Actualizar el sitio on the dashboard; returns the page it leads to.\"\"\"\n    action = button_action(c.get(\"/admin\").text, \"Actualizar el sitio\")\n    assert action, \"the dashboard has an Actualizar el sitio button\"\n    return c.post(action, data={\"csrf_token\": csrf_token(c)})\n\n\ndef test_leader_button_exports_then_uploads_and_reports_each_step(\n        client_as, published_post, button_action, csrf_token, uploads, public_site):\n    published_post(title=\"Crónica del Clásico Regio\")\n    leader = client_as(\"admin\")\n\n    page = update_site(leader, button_action, csrf_token)\n\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Sitio generado ✓ · Subido a GitHub ✓\" in text(page.text)\n    [sent] = uploads.sent\n    assert {\"index.html\", \"style.css\", \"posts/crónica-del-clásico-regio.html\"} <= sent, (\n        \"the upload ran after the export and was handed the exported site\")\n    assert (public_site / \"posts\" / \"crónica-del-clásico-regio.html\").exists()\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"848e789b-eb3c-42c9-b8c1-59d8ba6a5424","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"866aa3a5-de9e-4871-af02-52cb338083b0","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

Raises UploadFailed when the upload fails; the export\n    has been written by then and stays.\"\"\"\n    export(conn, out)\n    upload(out)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":7,"oldLines":6,"newStart":7,"newLines":8,"lines":[" from __future__ import annotations"," "," import sqlite3","+import subprocess","+import sys"," from collections.abc import Callable"," from pathlib import Path"," "]},{"oldStart":19,"oldLines":6,"newStart":21,"newLines":15,"lines":["     \"\"\"The exported site did not reach GitHub Pages; readers still see the old one.\"\"\""," "," ","+def upload_to_github_pages(site: Path) -> None:","+    \"\"\"Upload: push `site` to the gh-pages branch, which GitHub Pages serves. {"parentUuid":"01fb1760-434d-47ff-b546-13060c4598e4","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"fd0d2e60-edf5-48a7-925a-3055a462eab6","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01JBtfhdzLnSKHJianU4CFje","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/main.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"943d0664-87d5-488f-bf00-40870528f28d","timestamp":"2026-10-11T17:44:35.056Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/main.py","oldString":"from app import db, settings\nfrom app.routes import account, auth, dashboard, pages, posts, users\nfrom app.web import (CsrfRejected, Forbidden, LoginRequired, NicknameRequired, NotFound,\n                     render, require_csrf)\n\n\ndef create_app(database_path: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:\n    # Every route checks the CSRF token first, so no POST can forget it.\n    app = FastAPI(title=settings.SITE_TITLE, dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\n    app.state.database_path = database_path or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    db.init(app.state.database_path)","newString":"from app import db, settings, site_update\nfrom app.routes import account, auth, dashboard, pages, posts, users\nfrom app.site_update import Upload\nfrom app.web import (CsrfRejected, Forbidden, LoginRequired, NicknameRequired, NotFound,\n                     render, require_csrf)\n\n\ndef create_app(database_path: Path | None = None, site: Path | None = None,\n               upload: Upload | None = None) -> FastAPI:\n    \"\"\"The admin console on one SQLite file. Its site update exports to `site` and\n    puts it online with `upload`; tests pass a temporary folder and a fake.\"\"\"\n    # Every route checks the CSRF token first, so no POST can forget it.\n    app = FastAPI(title=settings.SITE_TITLE, dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\n    app.state.database_path = database_path or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    app.state.site = site or settings.SITE\n    app.state.upload = upload or site_update.upload_to_github_pages\n    db.init(app.state.database_path)","originalFile":"\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\n`create_app()` builds the admin console against one SQLite file. Routes live in\ntheir own modules under app/routes/; this file only wires them together.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.routes import account, auth, dashboard, pages, posts, users\nfrom app.web import (CsrfRejected, Forbidden, LoginRequired, NicknameRequired, NotFound,\n                     render, require_csrf)\n\n\ndef create_app(database_path: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:\n    # Every route checks the CSRF token first, so no POST can forget it.\n    app = FastAPI(title=settings.SITE_TITLE, dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\n    app.state.database_path = database_path or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    db.init(app.state.database_path)\n\n    # Signed, HTTP-only, same-site cookie holding the user id and CSRF token.\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=\"cms_session\", same_site=\"lax\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def to_login(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(app.url_path_for(\"login\"), status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(NicknameRequired)\n    def to_nickname(request: Request, exc: NicknameRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(app.url_path_for(\"nickname\"), status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(CsrfRejected)\n    def reject_form(request: Request, exc: CsrfRejected):\n        return render(request, \"admin/csrf_rejected.html\", status_code=403)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(Forbidden)\n    def refuse(request: Request, exc: Forbidden):\n        return render(request, \"admin/forbidden.html\", exc.user, status_code=403,\n                      reason=exc.reason)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(NotFound)\n    def not_found(request: Request, exc: NotFound):\n        return render(request, \"admin/not_found.html\", exc.user, status_code=404,\n                      missing=exc.missing)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n    app.include_router(account.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n\n    # The public site is the static export (ADR-001), not served here, so the\n    # server's front door is the admin console.\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def front_door(request: Request):\n        return RedirectResponse(app.url_path_for(\"dashboard\"), status_code=303)\n\n    return app\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":11,"oldLines":16,"newStart":11,"newLines":22,"lines":[" from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse"," from starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware"," ","-from app import db, settings","+from app import db, settings, site_update"," from app.routes import account, auth, dashboard, pages, posts, users","+from app.site_update import Upload"," from app.web import (CsrfRejected, Forbidden, LoginRequired, NicknameRequired, NotFound,","                      render, require_csrf)"," "," ","-def create_app(database_path: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:","+def create_app(database_path: Path | None = None, site: Path | None = None,","+               upload: Upload | None = None) -> FastAPI:","+    \"\"\"The admin console on one SQLite file. Its site update exports to `site` and","+    puts it online with `upload`; tests pass a temporary folder and a fake.\"\"\"","     # Every route checks the CSRF token first, so no POST can forget it.","     app = FastAPI(title=settings.SITE_TITLE, dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])","     app.state.database_path = database_path or settings.DATABASE_PATH","+    app.state.site = site or settings.SITE","+    app.state.upload = upload or site_update.upload_to_github_pages","     db.init(app.state.database_path)"," ","     # Signed, HTTP-only, same-site cookie holding the user id and CSRF token."]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"01fb1760-434d-47ff-b546-13060c4598e4","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"866aa3a5-de9e-4871-af02-52cb338083b0","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}
